import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
base=bpy.data.objects['OFICIAL | Entrada superior | lintel']
theta=base.rotation_euler.z
ex=Vector((math.cos(theta),math.sin(theta),0.0))
ey=Vector((-math.sin(theta),math.cos(theta),0.0))
origin=Vector((base.location.x,base.location.y,0.0))
names=['OFICIAL | Terminal alto | piso de entrada','OFICIAL | Terminal alto | galeria piso','OFICIAL | Terminal alto | galeria cobertura','OFICIAL | Terminal alto | apoio junto encosta','OFICIAL | Entrada superior | cobertura','OFICIAL | Passarela | piso continuo']
for name in names:
    o=bpy.data.objects.get(name)
    if not o:
        print('MISSING='+name);continue
    pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
    us=[(p-origin).dot(ex) for p in pts];vs=[(p-origin).dot(ey) for p in pts];zs=[p.z for p in pts]
    print(f'{name}|U=({min(us):.3f},{max(us):.3f})|V=({min(vs):.3f},{max(vs):.3f})|Z=({min(zs):.3f},{max(zs):.3f})')
